##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 16 July 2026 at 9:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, extending a ridge across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly north or northwest 2 to 4, increasing northeast 4 or 5 in the northeast of the area for a time overnight but variable in places throughout.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly north or northwest 3 to 5, but Variable 3 or less in the east, then increasing 5 or 6 in western waters overnight into Saturday. Becoming north or northwest 3 to 5 in all waters later on Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
